svg.aria-label: The A string with D major notes: in 1st position fingers 1 to 4 play B, C sharp, D, E; in 2nd position C sharp, D, E, F sharp; in 3rd position D, E, F sharp, G. D5 is finger 3 in 1st position and finger 1 in 3rd position
svg.text: 1st, 2nd and 3rd position on the A string
D major notes. A new position moves the whole hand; the 1st finger shows where the hand sits.
D5 = finger 3 in 1st position = finger 1 in 3rd position
From Chapter 1 of this post. Other keys move a finger by a half-step (C or F natural). Not to scale.
